name: rece-repo-inta-read-rout
description: Use when the user says they already cloned several repos locally and wants Hermes to inspect the newest repos, read their README/docs, then decide whether to learn from them, install them, or absorb reusable ideas. Best for local repo triage under ~ where recency matters more than a named target.

findings.excerpt: - If `pnpm` is missing but `npm` exists, a low-privilege fallback is `npm_config_prefix=$HOME/.npm-global npm install -g pnpm@<version>`; then prepend `$HOME/.n
- Do not assume `pip install -e .` is sufficient; compare with README extras such as `.[mcp]`.
- If README advertises `npx skills add ...`, verify locally first when possible.
- If remote listing via `npx skills add ... --list` times out, do not block the whole task; use local repo evidence if available and note the timeout explicitly
